content.text:
{
  "run_id": "20260926-004341-a31c",
  "verdicts": {
    "PASS": 4,
    "BUG": 1,
    "NEEDS_REVIEW": 2
  },
  "llm_calls": 5,
  "healed_steps": 0,
  "tests": [
    {
      "test": "Pilot signs in",
      "verdict": "PASS",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "why": "Replayed exactly; every step and oracle held.",
      "changelog_refs": [],
      "bug_report": null
    },
    {
      "test": "Plan and launch a survey mission",
      "verdict": "BUG",
      "confidence": 0.93,
      "why": "R4 violated: launched mission not listed (obs13) and UI blocks due to missing required Pilot field (obs12). No released changelog changes this behavior.",
      "changelog_refs": [],
      "bug_report": "## BUG: Plan and launch a survey mission\n\n**Verdict:** R4 violated: launched mission not listed (obs13) and UI blocks due to missing required Pilot field (obs12). No released changelog changes this behavior.\n\n**Business goal:** An operator plans a mission with an available drone and it appears in the Missions list as Scheduled\n\n**Reproduce:**\n1. Open /missions/new\n2. Name the mission = 'Survey a31c1'\n3. Choose mission type Survey = 'Survey'\n4. Choose the Pune Depot site = 'Pune Depot'\n5. Continue from mission details\n6. Continue with 'Continue'\n7. Assign drone Falcon-1\n8. Continue from drone selection\n9. Set altitude to 80 m = '80'\n10. Set speed to 8 m/s = '8'\n11. Continue from flight parameters\n12. Launch the mission\n13. Open the Missions list\n14. Open mission details to fill Pilot in command\n\n**Expected vs actual:**\n- `effect_mismatch` POST /api/missions/validate returned 200 (baseline 422)\n- `effect_mismatch` POST /api/missions/validate returned 422 (baseline 200)\n- `goal_unreachable` blocked at 'Fill new required field 'Pilot in command'': Pilot in command field not present; no navigation element to reach it from this page; page /missions/:id alerts []\n- `assertion_failed` The launched mission appears in the Missions list: expected text \"Survey a31c1\" not found on /missions/:id\n\n**Release notes check:** none of the release notes explain this behaviour.\n\n**Evidence:** screenshots/create-mission_12.jpg, screenshots/create-mission_13.jpg"
    },
    {
      "test": "Inspect a drone from the fleet table",
      "verdict": "PASS",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "why": "Replayed exactly; every step and oracle held.",
      "changelog_refs": [],
      "bug_report": null
    },
    {
      "test": "Pilot signs out",
      "verdict": "PASS",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "why": "Replayed exactly; every step and oracle held.",
      "changelog_refs": [],
      "bug_report": null
    },
    {
      "test": "Pilot updates display name",
      "verdict": "PASS",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "why": "Replayed exactly; every step and oracle held.",
      "changelog_refs": [],
      "bug_report": null
    },
    {
      "test": "Altitude above 120 m is rejected",
      "verdict": "NEEDS_REVIEW",
      "confidence": 0.78,
      "why": "Observed step reordering (obs2-obs8) conflicts with expected flow, but no changelog entry documents this functional change; outcome still passes R1.",
      "changelog_refs": [],
      "bug_report": null
    },
    {
      "test": "Low-battery drone cannot be assigned",
      "verdict": "NEEDS_REVIEW",
      "confidence": 0.4,
      "why": "Observed drone with 12% battery is correctly disabled per R2; no regression or documented change detected",
      "changelog_refs": [],
      "bug_report": null
    }
  ]
}
